mainEntity.name: I want wainscoting installed, but what should I do first before I call someone?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best first step is to measure the room and decide the wainscoting style, height, and trim profile before any material is ordered. A professional installer can then check wall condition, locate studs, and plan around outlets, doors, and corners so the finished layout looks balanced.
acceptedAnswer.description: Measure the space, choose the style and height, and note outlets, doors, and problem walls. That lets the installer price the job accurately and plan a clean layout.
